title: 2 Thessalonians 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: The apostle blesses God for the growing state of the love and patience of the Thessalonians.
And encourages them to persevere under all their sufferings for Christ, considering his coming at the great day of account.

title: 2 Thessalonians 2: chapter overview
paragraphs: Cautions against the error that the time of Christ's coming was just at hand. There would first be a general apostasy from the faith, and a revealing of the antichristian man of sin.
His destruction, and that of those who obey him.
The security of the Thessalonians from apostacy; an exhortation to stedfastness, and prayer for them.

title: 2 Thessalonians 3: chapter overview
paragraphs: The apostle expresses confidence in the Thessalonians, and prays for them.
He charges them to withdraw from disorderly walkers, particularly from the lazy and busybodies.
And concludes with a prayer for them, and a greeting.
